entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer serves as an official Hermes Agent provider, offering multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available through a managed cloud or an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows for agents across 25+ LLM providers. It supports deployment via Docker, Kubernetes, or managed cloud, with client libraries available for Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an official Hermes Agent provider that organizes context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system to achieve a 91% token reduction and archives sessions as editable Markdown files.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This open-source platform gives agents persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It runs locally on CPU without requiring external LLM API keys and supports custom data models and ontologies.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory is an official Hermes Agent provider featuring a custom vector graph engine that supports sub-300ms recall at scale. The system maintains auto-updated user profiles and offers multi-modal extraction from PDFs, images, and videos.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain stores facts with provenance, allowing for corrections and withdrawals of stored information. It exposes memory via MCP over Tailscale or local connections and includes a synthesis layer for cited answers.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents that tracks peer-centric representations through background reasoning. It is implemented as a FastAPI server and serves as the upstream library for the Hermes-specific self-hosted wrapper.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official Hermes Agent provider manages a plain markdown context tree using git-like version control for commits, branches, and merges. It features a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based, enabling sub-100ms performance.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that requires only Python 3.10 and a single SQLite database. It features episodic compression to manage storage growth and supports integrations with MCP and OpenWebUI.
entries.moorcheh-ai/memanto: Memanto extracts durable knowledge from ephemeral conversation streams and reconciles conflicting information by superseding old beliefs. It allows users to export their memory estates as plain Markdown via the Open Knowledge Format.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent utilizes vector search on Qdrant and structured facts to manage agent context. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context over other data.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that generates playbooks and training artifacts from task runs to assist agents with complex tasks. It supports various endpoints including Anthropic and self-hosted vLLM, accessible via CLI or MCP server.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin utilizes a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure message persistence without data loss. It provides specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall to help Hermes Agent recover specific details from its context engine.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes session history from 35 different coding agents to provide shared cross-tool memory without using models or external servers. It tracks file edits and command statuses locally, allowing agents to search through months of past session data.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports local inference servers and any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider to maintain persistence across different sessions.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI offers a local-first memory and identity layer that supports real-time ingestion from platforms like Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub. It maintains portable state across various clients and demonstrates high answer accuracy on LongMemEval benchmarks.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer uses a human-readable YAML engram format to store context on local disks for multi-agent systems. It employs local-first retrieval methods, including BGE-small and optional rerankers, to synchronize context across different coding tools.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely without cloud dependencies or API keys. It captures agent decisions and preferences from transcripts using a combination of BM25, vector search, and multi-graph traversal.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This five-package plugin family provides durable, file-based long-term memory using a SQLite-backed hierarchical schema and FTS5 search. It distinguishes itself by requiring zero vector databases and zero embedding models for its architecture.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This project optimizes long-context inference for Hermes Agent by reordering text and multimodal context to improve prefix-cache sharing. It features a context index for deduplication and cache-aware scheduling to maintain accuracy during LLM inference.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This embedded in-process plugin provides explainable retrieval by tagging every recalled item with a reason for its selection. It includes built-in primitives for tracking contradictions and resolving conflicts within the agent's memory.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: Agentcairn uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It utilizes a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search, ensuring memory remains daemonless and user-owned.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This proactive memory CLI allows agents to autonomously maintain and evolve source-grounded knowledge across sessions using local SQLite and Wiki files. It also supports team synchronization through a self-hosted server with integrated permission controls.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This MCP-native server uses an anticipatory cache to prefetch context by monitoring agent session logs in real time. It relies on local-first storage via SQLite-vec and GGUF models to provide RAG and vector search capabilities.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner for Hermes agents. It utilizes SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to manage state and provides purpose-built evidence packets to the agent for each query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory using semantic search through BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for codebases and multimedia with OCR support, using edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: This project reduces prompt token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 by using local BM25 tool ranking to select relevant keywords. It includes a dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: This Git-backed context layer provides first-class adapters for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex. It uses Markdown for durable context and decision logs, requiring manual review for integration enablement and context updates.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database to surface high-priority memories via importance-weighted recall. It supports BM25 keyword search, named graph relationships, and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that supports real, immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer to prevent persistent summaries from affecting recall. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log to track every prefetch and memory operation.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, scripts, runbooks, and MCP server configurations for agent routing. It offers five native tools for artifact retrieval and uses session hooks to provide concise system-prompt hints.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail enables agents to handle x402 payments using a TypeScript SDK and an MCP server for budget-bound wallets. It supports USDC and stablecoins across EVM and Solana without requiring a backend, database, or API keys.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables cross-agent continuity by allowing Hermes to read memories from other connected agents. It uses native lifecycle hooks for session snapshots and a local SQLite layer for caching and write outbox reliability.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It includes tools for manual memory storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking for retrieval.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory through deterministic slash commands for searching and syncing repositories. It requires a local SourceVault server for indexing and supports LLM-callable tools for models with structured tool use.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon and includes MinHash deduplication.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 specialized tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal within the Hermes ecosystem. It utilizes a hybrid search architecture combining BM25, vector, and graph methods, while featuring automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve information.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This lightweight, file-based kit focuses on memory hygiene by identifying stale or conflicting facts through 'rot' and 'lint' curators. It operates using plain markdown files and JSON diffs, leveraging a local git repository to track and revert changes without the need for a database.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework automates specification elicitation and implementation planning while enforcing TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It functions as a software development methodology that integrates with multiple coding harnesses and CLI tools.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system for generating web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts with native support for the Hermes Agent runtime via DeepSeek Harness. It enables agents to export designs into various formats including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms to provide standardized cybersecurity capabilities.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables the conversion of codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language. It supports incremental synchronization to preserve manual layouts and offers both a CLI and an MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project provides a master router for natural-language mandates and delegated permissions. It incorporates x402 payments and escrow services alongside a dedicated verification and dispute resolution layer.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI patterns using professional, technical, or casual voice profiles. It is compatible with agentskills.io agents like Hermes and supports detect-only, rewrite, and edit-in-place modes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project automates skill deduplication and quality improvement through a background evolution process called Agentic Evolver. It unifies skill libraries across multiple devices and team members, integrating with Hermes, Codex, and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state within a project's documentation folder and supports Claude Code and Codex.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,176 markdown-based skills covering 35 professions that run natively in Hermes Agent without requiring accounts or telemetry. It provides ready-to-paste exports for assistants including ChatGPT, Gemini, and Cursor.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This tool allows Hermes Agent and other platforms to search YouTube, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with OpenClaw, Cursor, and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, providing slash commands to manage and save identified patterns.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: These skills enable Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical lenses for specific tasks. The system reports findings while explicitly identifying potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It includes sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host while offering tools to read bundled resources.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill enables literate programming by generating documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs edits back to the original documentation.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents through Lite or Full complexity modes. It features a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models to ensure quality before handoff.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro coordinates agent teams using the SLP protocol and a mechanism kernel for SQLite storage and event logging. It distributes prompt-first working methods as Markdown recipes and structured skills.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory through markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on recorded work.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides a registry of Portuguese-language skills and guides for VPS deployment and MCP integration. Users can install these localized skills via a CLI tap or raw URLs.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Built on the Agent Skills specification, this project enables interactions with oracle networks including CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. These developer tools are designed for installation via the Vercel CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills support FLUX image and video generation through BFL API integration, including polling and webhooks. The suite includes eight specialist skills specifically for FLUX 3 video workflows.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts code repositories and developer discourse into verified instruction files compliant with the agentskills.io spec. It maps instructions to specific source lines and includes automated workflows for testing and exporting skills.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika converts plain-text job descriptions into .nika workflow files using a local-first Rust binary. It audits costs and tool permissions before execution and generates hash-chained records to verify run integrity.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification, accessible via a Python client or CLI. It supports recursive dependency resolution and includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for autonomous long-running tasks, this skill provides real-time tracking of decisions and progress checkpoints. It includes built-in rollback procedures to ensure safe recovery during complex multi-step executions.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts using WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS via Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for configuration.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This project serves as a hub for browsing, searching, and one-click installation of community skills. It implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification and features federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This tool provides a 5-layer intelligent retrieval system using hard triggers, FTS5, synonyms, dense embeddings, and RRF fusion. It reduces token usage by narrowing skill lists before LLM calls and supports graceful degradation if dependencies are missing.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and enables incremental discovery of tool schemas and server metadata.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly personal execution OS, this project features agent-driven scheduling via MCP connections. It manages data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only skill performs adversarial code reviews by using three parallel subagents to attack code from different angles. It combines deterministic pre-scans with verified findings via proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across surfaces including CLI, TUI, Discord, and Telegram. It supports 97 languages and can reduce token usage by 20–80% per rewrite through its five-dimensional scoring system.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This multi-agent skill simplifies code using three parallel sub-agents focused on Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness. It supports TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and Rust through a tiered application process with an approval gate.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and uses a Python goal engine for persistent task state management.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides over 2,000 skills and 131+ tools for network, forensics, and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, and OWASP, to support CVE-driven tasks.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# / .NET implementation of agentskills.io features progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based loading and supports automatic registration of common skill directories.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: These production-tested skills provide commands for session tracking, worktree recovery, and PR orchestration. They install as drop-in markdown files into agent-specific directories and include a bundled installer for managing updates.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent, tracking token costs, session history, and skill analytics without outbound telemetry. It enforces strict read-only data access and supports optional incident alerting through Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill enables agents to generate reproducible demo GIFs for repositories by creating vhs or Playwright recording scripts. It supports terminal interfaces and web apps, optimizing output files to remain under an 8 MB target size.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool allows agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides installation commands for discovered plugins and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project establishes a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify skill gaps and proposing structured updates. It gates these improvements behind an evaluation framework using deterministic and LLM-judge tests while running entirely locally.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates portable agent skills and extensions while monitoring official specifications to prevent field drift. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain compliant with runtime-specific profiles.
entries.superagnt/leverage: Leverage provides skills for social data enrichment, CRM management, and lead generation across platforms like Claude Code and Cursor. The suite includes an MCP server to handle browser-based OAuth authentication for these services.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection offers specialized tools for transcribing Douyin videos, performing OCR via macOS Vision, and refining AI-generated Chinese text. It focuses on practical workflows like converting video content to structured Markdown and extracting data from images.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This skill set manages deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. it ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax and verifies project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols such as x402 and MPP. It is designed for compatibility with the OpenClaw and Hermes Agent standards to facilitate machine-to-machine transactions.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Skillseal provides a functional quality seal by testing agent skills for structure, security, and functionality within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to confirm a skill's operational integrity.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin enables users to earn or distribute USDC on the Base network by solving support bounties via the x402 protocol. It allows for listing bounties and submitting drafts without requiring an account or API key, paying out 85% to the winner upon human approval.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project provides structured web data access across 31 platforms through an MCP server exposing 191 different tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This project provides Hermes Agent with a multi-scale Chinese news briefing skill that processes information ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search expansion with user interests, generating structured reports that include core conclusions and actionable suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, across terminal, desktop, and IDE environments. It is included for users seeking a package-managed approach to development tools on Nix-supported systems.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables mobile deployment by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and connectivity with both local Ollama models and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments by enforcing single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable gateway, API, and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android (Termux) and iOS (iSH), this project brings the Hermes AI assistant to mobile platforms. It distinguishes itself by integrating Telegram for voice and file messaging alongside support for scheduled cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing for configurable security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying and operating Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes via Helm charts. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that combines the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It offers a hybrid management system for skills and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to orchestrate multiple agent instances with distinct identities and workspaces from a single web application. It manages granular permissions for tools and networks while providing dedicated Telegram and WhatsApp communication channels.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting headless Ubuntu and Debian environments, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for production-ready autonomous execution of recurring AI tasks via cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents to perform fundamental, sentiment, and technical financial analysis. It features a research team that debates bullish and bearish perspectives and supports backtesting with SEC EDGAR integration and point-in-time data integrity.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, memory browsing, and cost tracking. Users can manage multi-agent workflows through a Web UI, CLI, or MCP server, with support for local Node.js or Docker deployments.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent, using tmux for persistent background execution. It provides TUI and web-based dashboards with diff review capabilities and supports sandboxing via Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Designed for scaling Hermes Agent from single instances to automated teams, this template utilizes a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms across 23+ LLM providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts to manage agent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This platform provides a centralized screen for supervising autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board and live streaming of agent reasoning. It requires human-in-the-loop verification for all agent-proposed task completions to ensure oversight.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for precise routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using Hermes Agent profiles and the MCP and ACP protocols. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles via a Kanban flow.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates evaluations for TBLite and TerminalBench-2 while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to vie for GitHub stars. Using Paperclip and Hermes Agent for execution, the system visualizes agent tasks and scoreboard metrics on a real-time dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling, utilizing parallel model querying and synthesis without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It features a built-in MCP server and auto-syncs the index on every file change to maintain up-to-date context.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI tool that tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes, through a terminal UI and 3D visualization dashboard. It allows users to monitor their consumption and submit data to public leaderboards and profiles.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while redacting authentication headers for security. It exports trace sessions into self-contained HTML files for detailed analysis of agent interactions.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading Hermes Agent state directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers detailed usage breakdowns by model, session, and project.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance to Hermes Agent via MCP servers to improve UI construction. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown and integrates directly into the agent's workflow.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer adds 36 skills and 6 specialized workflows to Hermes Agent, coordinating seven agent roles through a CTO loop. It automates the entire lifecycle of an application, from building and deployment to health checks and log observation.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with YAML-based themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. The tool modifies visual elements such as banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing Hermes Agent approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows across various AI providers.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable @handles. It enables Hermes Agent to participate in commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to run natively within the Claude Code Channel without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that evaluates AI agent configurations and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring. It identifies ambiguous tool overlaps and missing progress conditions, generating SARIF or JSON reports for CI integration.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports chat platforms like Slack and Telegram, extending the persistent memory capabilities available to agents.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent operations. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for finance, devops, and research, supported by automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a TAW Agent framework that enables per-folder scoping for Hermes Agents, allowing for project-local memories and custom instructions. It facilitates seamless switching between default and scoped agents based on the local configuration and skills defined within a directory.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides immediate access to 29 community plugins and supports free models to ensure a zero-cost production environment.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions users from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also configures systemd gateway services and handles the conversion of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco provides self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry without cloud dependencies. It uses config-aware baselines to detect performance drift and offers both passive zero-token analysis and active probing.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for local runtime by default, this project focuses on secure task execution by requiring explicit approval for all external writes and consequential actions. It includes specific contracts for managing opportunities and offer-previews to help users generate income using Hermes Agent.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant adds offline, wake-word capabilities to Hermes Agent without requiring API keys or accounts. It supports 35 languages and features adaptive turn-taking, allowing users to interact with their agent through a fully local voice interface.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search for managing agent information. It includes a built-in circuit breaker to handle MemOS API outages while providing tools to search, add, and delete memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager centralizes the administration of MCP, skills, and prompts for Hermes Agent and other CLI tools on Windows, macOS, and Linux. It eliminates the need for manual editing of JSON, TOML, and YAML configuration files through a unified interface.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that supports autonomous multi-step tasks with user approval and file access for various agent CLIs. It features built-in assistants for generating editable office documents and enables 24/7 unattended automation via cron and remote access.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This web interface provides 1:1 parity with Hermes CLI features for use on browsers and mobile devices. Built with Python and vanilla JS, it utilizes a three-panel layout to organize chat, sessions, and workspace browsing.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app offers guided installation with dependency resolution for Hermes Agent across multiple AI providers and local endpoints. The GUI includes dedicated modules for chat, session management, memory, and tool configuration.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: Ekko-studio is a web dashboard that supports visual workflows with schedules, human approval gates, and unified configuration for 10 platforms including Telegram and Discord. It also provides usage analytics for tracking token breakdown and costs.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex task management. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and an MCP catalog for comprehensive environment control.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent workspace that aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents and custom ACP-compatible registrations. It can be deployed as a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container, with native iOS and Android clients for remote access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This native Mac workspace provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts for real-time session data and system repair. It includes an embedded terminal for shell access alongside native views for Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop app includes a built-in kernel for health checks and updates. The interface supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering while providing native window and process management for Hermes Agent.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser contexts to local, cloud, or self-hosted Hermes Agent runtimes. It offers site-aware drafting assistance across 31 writing environments and tools for tab triage and multi-agent switching.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a SwiftUI iPhone app that pairs with a self-hosted hermes-webui server to drive agents from a mobile device. It supports real-time chat streaming with tool-call details and provides mobile management for server file systems and skills.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop workspace offering one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines with custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking token usage and latency alongside a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, system metrics, and real-time chat with tool call visualization. It functions as an MCP server control plane and includes the ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that tracks per-session quota burn and API-equivalent costs for Codex and Claude. It builds local search indexes to allow users to query prompts, tool calls, and errors across 16 different agent formats.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a specialized approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It incorporates a kanban board for task management alongside tools for managing profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based mobile UI allows users to run a Hermes dashboard as a Telegram Mini App with support for five concurrent background agent instances. It features terminal chat with file attachments and secures sessions using HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This no-install Windows desktop solution runs via portable Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools for tasks like TTS and ComfyUI image creation, managed through a built-in workflow engine.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes integrated tools for browsing files and managing skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: Focused on process monitoring, this dashboard provides real-time tracking of session activity and API costs. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This chat-first workspace features real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for secure agent interaction. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client facilitates orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents managed by a PM orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and supports streaming SSE responses with model switching.
